description: Add a part to the SendCutSend account from a file and wait for the site to process it. Pass either dxf_text (the content of a DXF file, up to 1 MiB) or upload_url (from get_upload_url, after uploading). Returns the part's ID for quote_part and create_saved_cart, its measured size, and any problems that stop it being priced. If processing takes longer than the wait, the part comes back with processed=false: call get_part later.

dxf_text.description: the whole content of a DXF file

filename.description: the part's file name, shown on the website; with dxf_text it must end in .dxf

units.description: the drawing's units: in or mm; leave empty to let SendCutSend detect them

upload_url.description: the upload_url from get_upload_url, after the file was PUT to it

name: create_part

contours.description: closed outlines found, the outer edge included

errors.description: problems that stop the part being priced

format.description: what SendCutSend thinks it is: sheet, tube and so on

id.description: the part ID quote_part and create_saved_cart take

preview_url.description: an image of the part as SendCutSend sees it

processed.description: false while SendCutSend is still processing the file; call get_part again later

quotable.description: whether the part can be priced: processed and without errors

description: Create a saved cart on the SendCutSend account holding parts, each with optional services (checked as in quote_part), and return a checkout_url. Give the user the checkout_url: opening it while signed in loads the parts into their cart to review and pay. Nothing is ordered or paid here. The account's own cart must be empty, because SendCutSend builds a saved cart from everything in it; this tool adds its parts, saves, and takes them out again. A saved cart can't be changed afterwards; create another and delete the old one instead.

material_sku.description: a SKU from list_materials or quote_part

services.description: bending, tapping and finishing; omit for cut only

bends.description: how to bend each bend line; when bending, every bend line from get_part_features must be listed

direction.description: up or down, seen from the drawing's front

deburring.description: deburr the part (SendCutSend adds it with powder coating)

powder.description: powder coat colour value from list_finishes, e.g. matte_black

tap.description: tap size, e.g. M4 x 0.7 or 10-32

description: Get a pre-signed URL to upload a part file (DXF, DWG, AI, EPS or STEP) to, for files you can't pass to create_part inline. Upload with an HTTP PUT of the raw file, e.g. curl -fsS -T part.step '<upload_url>', within 15 minutes, then call create_part with the same upload_url. Uploaded files are publicly readable by anyone who has the URL.

description: Price a part for a quantity. Without material_sku, price cutting in every material that can cut it, cheapest first (optionally only one category). With material_sku, price that material only, with price breaks and estimated ship and delivery dates, and with services (bends, taps, finish) if given: each service's cost and a grand total. Services are checked against the part's geometry and the material's rules first. Prices are in USD, before shipping and tax.
